_doc: Block-hash allowlist for tn-claim-guard.py 'prohibited_public_positioning' rules. Entries only allow specific known-good contexts; the guard identifies them by SHA-256 of the enclosing HTML block, not by line number, so any edit to a whitelisted block silently invalidates the exemption and re-fails the guard. Regex C is now noun-agnostic (installer/dealer/distributor/partner/reseller/fabricator, bare 'Authorized' labels, 'manufacturer-authorized'), and editorial third-party phrasing is separated structurally (a first-party ACG subject is required) rather than by entry, so only two narrow classes are listed here: (1) architect spec-section and blog checklist text that states what a SPEC should require of the installer, which is not an ACG self-claim, and (2) the byte-frozen West Palm Beach pages and the site-root-adjacent WPB paths, whose copy cannot be edited while .github/seo/url-primaries.json frozen_prefixes is in force. Class (2) entries are debt, not approval: they must be removed together with the copy as soon as the WPB freeze lifts.
